faq.question: What insurance plans do you accept?
faq.answer: We accept most major PPO plans including Blue Cross, Aetna, and UnitedHealthcare. Call our front desk to verify your specific plan.

faq.question: How do I schedule an appointment?
faq.answer: Call us at (916) 555-0142 or use our online patient portal. Same-day appointments are often available for urgent concerns.

faq.question: Where are you located?
faq.answer: We are at 123 Granite Bay Blvd, Suite 200, Granite Bay, CA 95746. Free parking is available in the building lot.
